ENGLISH: German militarism was a broad cultural and social phenomenon between 1815 and 1945, which developed out of the creation of standing armies in the 18th century. The numerical increase of militaristic structures in the Holy Roman Empire led to an increasing influence of military culture deep into civilian life. Strengthens army tactics and discipline and the combat performance of capital ships. Effects: reinforcement rate +5% / organization recovery +10% / military tactics +10% / maximum dig-in +1 / land unit discipline +10%, attack +0.5, defense +0.5 / battleship gun power +2, hull +1 / dreadnought gun power +2, hull +1.

The Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, often shortened to the Red Army, was the army and air force of the Bolshevik Party, Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic and, after 1922, the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics. Strengthens army reinforcement, trench defense, and sustained combat capability. Effects: reinforcement rate +15% / organization recovery +15% / military tactics +5% / maximum dig-in +2 / land unit discipline +5%, formation time -5 days, organization +2.5.

The Royal Navy (RN) is the United Kingdom's naval warfare force and a component of His Majesty's Naval Service. Strengthens fleet firepower, hull strength, speed, and organization. Effects: naval unit gun power +1, hull +1, speed +0.5, organization +5.

La Grande Armee (French for 'The Great Army') was the main military component of the French Imperial Army commanded by Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte during the Napoleonic Wars. Strengthens army attack, discipline, and organization recovery. Effects: organization recovery +10% / land unit discipline +10%, attack +1.

The Imperial Austrian Army formed the land forces of the Austrian Empire. It arose from the remains of the Imperial Army of the Holy Roman Emperor after its dissolution and in 1867 was reformed into the Common Army of Austria-Hungary and the Imperial-Royal Landwehr after the Austro-Hungarian Compromise of 1867. Strengthens army defense, discipline, and the attack power of elite units. Effects: organization recovery +5% / land unit discipline +10%, defense +1 / guard and stormtrooper attack +1 / hussar attack +1.

The unification of Italy (Italian: Unita d'Italia), also known as the Risorgimento, was the 19th-century political and social movement that resulted in the consolidation of different states of the Italian Peninsula and its outlying isles into a single state in 1861, the Kingdom of Italy. Strengthens the combat capability of the unified army and the organization of elite units. Effects: organization recovery +10% / land unit attack +0.5, defense +0.5 / guard and stormtrooper organization +2.5.

The American Dream is the national ethos of the United States, a set of ideals including representative democracy, rights, liberty, and equality, in which freedom is interpreted as the opportunity for individual prosperity and success, as well as upward social mobility for oneself and their children, achieved through hard work in a capitalist society with few barriers. Improves agricultural and mining production efficiency to support the frontier economy. Effects: farming efficiency +10% / mining efficiency +10%.

Tsarist autocracy, also called Tsarism, was a form of absolute monarchy localised with the Grand Duchy of Moscow and its successor states the Tsardom of Russia and the Russian Empire. Strengthens standing-army reinforcement, formation, and organization. Effects: reinforcement rate +15% / land unit discipline +5%, formation time -5 days, organization +2.5 / organization recovery +10%.

Samurai were the hereditary military nobility and officer caste of medieval and early-modern Japan from the late 12th century until their abolition in the 1870s during the Meiji era. They were the well-paid retainers of the daimyo, the great feudal landholders. Strengthens army discipline, land combat capability, and reinforcement. Effects: reinforcement rate +5% / organization recovery +10% / land unit discipline +10%, attack +0.5, defense +0.5.
